summary:
Fixed and verified. ✅

**The needle:** `Product.hashCode()` in `src/Product.java` hashed by `category` instead of `sku`. Since `equals()` keys on SKU but `hashCode()` keyed on category — and there are only ~10 categories — all 10,000 products collided into ~10 buckets, exploding max chain length (~1000) and causing the performance cliff. This also violated the equals/hashCode contract.

**The fix:** changed `hashCode()` to return `sku.hashCode()`, matching `equals()`.

**Result:** test passes — max chain length dropped from ~1000 to **4**, with items spread across 5,991 buckets.
